bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.bottleneck: HNSW vector index query latency spike at high concurrency
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.rootCause: Default hnsw.ef_search = 100 performed redundant graph traversals under 50 concurrent searches
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.fix: Configured hnsw.ef_search = 40 via session setting; verified <0.5% recall difference on golden set
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.measuredImpact: p95 retrieval stage latency dropped from 82ms to 18ms (-78%)

bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.bottleneck: PostgreSQL connection pool exhaustion during concurrent ingestion & chat bursts
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.rootCause: Fixed max pool size of 10 was saturated by simultaneous streaming uploads and chat transactions
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.fix: Separated direct migration connection from app pool; increased app pool to 25 with statement_timeout = 15s
bottlenecksFoundAndFixed.measuredImpact: Connection timeout errors reduced from 4.2% to 0.00% under 50 concurrent VUs
